text:
emma: Originate candidate build candidate-17 ready for ops gating. Pinning artifacts: docker:redwood/inference:canary-17 and model:v2.4.3-rc1. Requesting gatekeeper/sheriff sign-off and KV warm before promo. Proposed quiet window 21:00-23:00 UTC tonight. Quick checklist below — please ack: pin artifacts, kv-warm, canary 1% -> 10%, telemetry smoke. https://ci.redwood/reports/12345 :eyes:

deploy-bot: [CI] candidate created: candidate-17 (build 784). Artifacts uploaded: s3://ci/candidate-17/, images pushed. Triggered kv-warm job id=kv-784.

raj: Ack from infra side. Ran local smoke against candidate-17, basic flows OK. Notes on rollback: we should be ready to flip traffic back to stable tag and restore kv prefixes. Minimal rollback commands below:

```
# rollback to last stable image
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-2026.03.12 -n prod
# revert routing shim
curl -X POST "$DEPLOY_API/traffic/shim" -d '{"route":"legacy-route"}'
# deploy-bot rollback trigger
deploy-bot rollback --deployment candidate-17 --reason "auto-rollback"
```

marta: pinging model team — candidate currently built with quant q4f16. Can we pin model variant to q4f16-2026-03 for this promotion? It changes memory footprint, but latency looks fine in staging. Also suggest setting model routing policy to prefer dedicated nodes for prod traffic.

olivia: Release notes draft is up: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/candidate-17.md. Added embedding API change note and migration snippet. Will finalize after gatekeeper ack; need one line about behavior for missing function-calls.

sheriff-oncall: I'm available for the 21:00 UTC window. Setting myself as primary sheriff. Quiet window applied in calendar and PD. I'll be at console 20:45 UTC. :white_check_mark: If anything looks off, I'll trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: KV warm job started: kv-warm --target candidate-17 --keys 1m --threads 8 --prefixes auto
[log] warming prefixes from s3 list (approx 1.1M keys)
[log] 25% complete...
[log] completed in 2m 42s — cache size 1.2GB.

emma: Canary plan: route 1% of prod traffic to candidate-17 for 15m. If p95 < 150ms and error rate < 0.5% then step to 10% for 30m. Telemetry dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/rc-17 (watch p95, 99th, error-rate, and token-cost). Ops please watch CPU/GPU util on serving pods — we expect a slight increase due to kv warming.

raj: lgtm. I agree with the thresholds. I'll be watching autoscaler events and have rollback commands handy.

olivia: I updated the release email template and will send a heads-up to the early-adopter list at 20:50 UTC. Link to docs already in the draft.

marta: Confirmed model pin to q4f16-2026-03 in deployment config. Also added a fallback policy to scale down model to q8 if memory pressure kicks in.

sheriff-oncall: Signed off from ops side — sheriff ack. Proceed with canary at 21:00 UTC unless anyone objects in next 10m.

emma: Go/no-go window reached, promoting candidate-17 canary 1% now. deploy-bot will report status.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary promotion started: candidate-17 -> prod at 2026-03-21T21:00:05Z
[deploy] traffic split: stable:99% candidate-17:1%
[monitor] initial metrics: p95=132ms, errors=0.12%, cpu=58%, gpu=45%

raj: Seeing normal metrics. No errors spike. Holding for the 15m observation.

olivia: Sending in-progress note to early adopters.

sheriff-oncall: On watch. All clear so far.

emma: After 15m hold, if everything stays green we'll ramp to 10% for 30m. If green after that, full promotion and final pin of artifacts.

raj: If rollback needed, I'll execute the rollback snippet above and coordinate with sheriff.

olivia: Final release notes link (public): https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-21-candidate-17.html — added migration snippet and a short FAQ.

sheriff-oncall: No objections. Approving full ramp after 10% hold if telemetry remains stable.

emma: Thanks all — recording this thread in release docket. :sparkles:

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary ramp to 10% complete at 2026-03-21T21:30:12Z — monitoring continues.

raj: +1 from infra. Ready for full promote on green.

(threads end)
